description: Inline APG spinbutton time-of-day selector: hours/minutes/(seconds) with +/−, optional AM/PM, an hour/minute radiogroup grid (2D roving tabindex), host-owned presets / Now / recents, and a JS module for keys, typeahead, auto-repeat and fit. Null Value renders -- in the readout; +/− starts from now rounded to the step. Square fit opens the grid on a segment tap (replacing presets) and collapses ShowGrid to None when seconds would overflow the 260 px sheet. Popup/Auto presentation of TmTimePicker composes this selector into a dialog overlay.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The bound time of day. Null renders -- in the readout; +/− starts from now rounded to the step (or MinTime).

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires on every accepted step, typeahead or period change, including a value outside MinTime/MaxTime.

parameters.name: ValueExpression
parameters.description: Expression identifying the bound model field. Blazor supplies it automatically with @bind-Value; it links the selector to EditContext.NotifyFieldChanged.

parameters.name: MinuteStep
parameters.description: Minute step. Must be a positive divisor of 60 other than 60. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: EnforceStep
parameters.description: When true, an off-step bound value is marked invalid (aria-invalid + TmTimeSelector_OffStep) and never rewritten. The first +/− or a typed minute snaps onto the step. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: ReferenceDate
parameters.description: Date used with TimeZone for DST gap/ambiguity. Both must be set; a missing pair is a no-op.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Time zone used with ReferenceDate for DST gap/ambiguity. Both must be set.

parameters.name: AmbiguousTimeResolution
parameters.description: Which occurrence of an ambiguous civil time to prefer. Defaults to earlier.

parameters.name: AmbiguousOffsetChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen offset when the user resolves an ambiguous time.

parameters.name: ShowSeconds
parameters.description: When true, a seconds spinbutton is rendered after minutes. In a square fit the readout wraps two 44 px rows and ShowGrid collapses to None.

parameters.name: HourCycle
parameters.description: 12-hour versus 24-hour clock. Default Auto follows Culture (or CurrentCulture). Pass H23 to force 24-hour.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve HourCycle.Auto and to format bounds. Null uses CurrentCulture.

parameters.name: Fit
parameters.description: Fine layout. Auto is measured (square when width < 640 and height < 480); Square / Regular pin it and win over measurement. Prerender / no JS is regular.

parameters.name: ShowGrid
parameters.description: Whether the hour/minute grid shows. Square + seconds collapses the effective value to None even when Always (304 px would overflow the 260 px Flex-Window sheet). Square Auto opens the grid on a hours/minutes tap.

parameters.name: GridMinuteStep
parameters.description: Grid minute step. Null uses max(MinuteStep, 5). Must be a positive divisor of 60 other than 60 when set.

parameters.name: Presets
parameters.description: Host-owned named shortcuts rendered as native chips. The selector never persists them. A chip whose time is outside MinTime/MaxTime is aria-disabled.

parameters.name: ShowNowPreset
parameters.description: When true, a Now chip is offered. The time comes from the injected TimeProvider (fallback TimeProvider.System), rounded to MinuteStep. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: RecentTimes
parameters.description: Host-owned recent times. The selector never persists them. At most three chips render, deduplicated against Presets.

parameters.name: AllowTyping
parameters.description: Typeahead in the spinbuttons and the Type the time switch on a coarse pointer. The switch is never offered in a square fit (decision 15). Defaults to true.

parameters.name: EnableSwipe
parameters.description: Vertical swipe on a spinbutton. Unused until the swipe phase. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables every spinbutton and stepper. Distinct from ReadOnly.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the time visible and focusable but not editable: +/− are hidden (not merely disabled). Never assigned inside the component. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Invalid
parameters.description: External invalid state (host validation). Combined with the selector's own min/max check.

parameters.name: ErrorText
parameters.description: Error message rendered below the readout while invalid. Host text wins over the localized min/max message.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: aria-label of the group. Defaults to the localized Time picker label; ignored when AriaLabelledBy is set.

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.description: aria-labelledby of the group. When set, AriaLabel is not rendered.

parameters.name: MinTime
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound. A value below this bound stays on screen and is announced as invalid.

parameters.name: MaxTime
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound. A value above this bound stays on screen and is announced as invalid.

parameters.name: AllowOvernightRange
parameters.description: When true, MinTime after MaxTime is read as a range that crosses midnight ([min, 24:00) ∪ [00:00, max]). Defaults to false so today's same-day comparison is unchanged.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: Extra ids referenced from every spinbutton's aria-describedby. Joined with the selector's own error id and the surrounding TmFormField cascade.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Layout of the wrapping observer. Auto measures; any other value pins the mode and never imports the observer script. Never pair with ResolvedLayoutChanged as a two-way bind.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: Mode rendered before the first measurement. Defaults to desktop.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes. Never pair with a two-way bind of LayoutMode.

parameters.name: AutoFocus
parameters.description: Moves focus to the hours spinbutton after the first render.

parameters.name: OnCommitted
parameters.description: Fires once on a completed change (tap, typeahead with advance, end of auto-repeat), not on every arrow key.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Optional id used as the prefix of the hours spinbutton ({Id}-hours) and the error element ({Id}-error). When omitted a per-instance id is generated.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) applied to the group.
